name: sit-S01-adult-keys-bare-a
refs: The key sheet to edit: the same creature in every cell; edit only what the prompt names.
How this creature's bare head looks, with no leaves (project-owned).
prompt:
Edit the first reference. Keep every cell exactly as it is: the same creature, pose, size, place, outline, eyes, eye rings, colours, light and brush, the water droplets exactly where they are, and the same magenta background.

Every figure keeps its facing exactly as in the reference: the head toward the LEFT, the same as cell 1. Do not turn or mirror any figure.

Change only one thing in every cell: remove the leaf crest on top of the head and paint the bare head there. The bare head is round and whole, continuing the head's own dark coat, outline and top-left light, exactly like the bare head in the second reference, with no stub, no scar and no flat cut. Where a leaf crossed the body or a droplet, paint what lies behind it.

No new parts, no text, no borders, no shadow, no glow.
